title: Low-density Boolean functions with exponentially weak sub-half-size coalition influence
author: Jean Bourgain, Jeff Kahn, and Gil Kalai
work: Influential Coalitions for Boolean Functions I: Constructions
source_version: Theory of Computing20 (2024), Article4, publisher source publicationSeptember 30, 2024; DOI10.4086/toc.2024.v020a004

difficulty_reason: The selected theorem requires a random Boolean-function construction whose low density still blocks every sub-half-size coalition by exponentially small influence. Beyond the shared CNF estimates, ClaimsA–E build a subcube-incidence and random-resampling argument strong enough for exponentially tiny failure probability over all coalitions, which is an additional substantive local core beyond ordinary qualification-level concentration.
